equity.level_reason: Percentages are reported and described by educational attainment (a gradient from 12.2% to 33.6%), but not framed as a disparity, with no computed contrast; values are set side by side.

level_alternative.reason: The stated educational gradient with endpoint values could be read as a framed, quantified SES contrast.

equity.equity_measurement: Education is the SES proxy; the middle category values appear only in the figure.
